schema_note: Enriched retrodiction card: original candidate CARD + parameter AUDIT + adversarial SKEPTIC PANEL + REPAIR-AGENT/FERTILITY-JUDGE repair and scores, merged. Provenance of every block retained.

card.one_sentence_claim: Quantum contextuality (Kochen-Specker / Peres-Mermin) and complementarity are reframed as the generic noncommutation of idempotent packaging closures (route mismatch RM_d>0) onto incompatible record algebras, with a global noncontextual value assignment recast as the demand that all such closures commute -- a finite, Lean-certified structural possibility (noncommuting idempotents on Fin 4) that localizes the global-record premise smuggled into the standard no-go arguments, but does NOT reproduce the specific PM-square algebra and derives no new physics.
card.target_known_fact: Measurement contextuality: there is no single context-independent {0,1} value assignment to all observables consistent with functional relations among compatible sets (Kochen-Specker 1967; Peres-Mermin 1990 magic square, where the deterministic noncontextual assignment is obstructed by the product/anticommutation constraints of the six observables), and noncommuting observables are complementary (Bohr).
card.scientific_domain: Quantum foundations / information physics (contextuality, complementarity, measurement)

theory_basis.component: thm:dephase -- dephasing Delta(rho)=sum_i Pi_i rho Pi_i is idempotent with fixed points exactly the diagonal (record-classical) states; Lean dephase_idem, dephase_fixed_iff_exists_diagonal
theory_basis.role: Supplies the per-context packaging map: each measurement context = a record basis = a dephasing closure. PROVED + Lean-certified that each context map is an idempotent closure.

theory_basis.component: Route mismatch RM_d(E,F;rho)=d(EFrho,FErho) (trace distance) + certified finite witness: two noncommuting idempotents on Fin 4 (Lean mismatch_witness, not_commute_E_F)
theory_basis.role: Supplies the noncommutation primitive: incompatible record algebras give Delta_1 Delta_2 != Delta_2 Delta_1. Numerics: RM~0 for record-diagonal H, max 0.350099 for generic H. The Fin-4 witness certifies noncommuting idempotents EXIST, generically.

theory_basis.component: sec:no-go diagnosis: 'a single global record language ... amounts to ... a single packaging/value map across contexts'; KS/PM read as demanding a context-independent value assignment
theory_basis.role: Provides the interpretational mapping that identifies the noncontextual-value-assignment premise with a global commuting packaging map. This is an isolation of a premise, NOT a theorem; the PM-square instantiation is listed as future work.

theory_basis.component: Definability / strict-extension: predicate h definable from lens f iff constant on fibers; change of basis = strict extension of the record algebra (Lean definable_iff_constantOnFibers, refined_strictlyRefines_of_notDefinable)
theory_basis.role: Formalizes 'a context is not revealing a pre-existing value but extending the record algebra', giving the closure-theoretic reading of why a single global value language fails.

theory_basis.component: OI-EI principle (operational indiscernibility => identity at a layer) + three-certificate spine (idempotence = objects; route mismatch is NOT a directionality certificate)
theory_basis.role: Methodological frame: contextuality lives in the packaging/closure layer, route mismatch is a P3 protocol-geometry diagnostic kept distinct from the P6 arrow audit.

card.minimum_viable_result: A worked, deterministically reproducible (and ideally Lean-certified) Peres-Mermin instantiation: 6 two-qubit dephasing closures whose pairwise route-mismatch pattern matches the PM compatibility graph, together with a precise statement+proof that no global commuting idempotent E_* respecting the row/column product constraints exists -- i.e. the KS/PM no-go expressed as 'no global packaging closure'. This upgrades the current GENERIC noncommuting-idempotents witness (Fin 4) to a SPECIFIC contextuality witness, discharging the future-work item at line 888.
card.fallback_result: If the full PM no-go-as-closure-noncommutation proves too hard, the defensible minimum is the already-existing result restated cleanly: (i) thm:dephase makes each context an idempotent closure (Lean), (ii) the Fin-4 witness certifies noncommuting closures exist (Lean), (iii) numerics give RM_d=0.350099 generic / ~0 record-diagonal, and (iv) sec:no-go isolates the global-commuting-packaging premise. This is an HONEST reframing/premise-isolation (recovery, not derivation), matching the candidate's class-D grading, with the PM instantiation flagged as open.
card.why_scientists_care: Contextuality and complementarity are at the heart of quantum no-go theorems and are now resources for quantum computation; a clean, auditable statement of WHERE the noncontextual-value premise enters (and a single primitive -- noncommuting idempotent closures) is valuable as a unifying bookkeeping discipline. It pinpoints the exact 'global commuting record language' premise that KS/PM/Bell arguments smuggle in, and identifies the precise repair frontier (a record-algebra/pointer-basis selection rule, a named missing interface) that would upgrade the reframing toward a genuine selection law.
card.recommended_artifact: A deterministic, seeded computational notebook plus a Lean module: instantiate the Peres-Mermin square as 6 two-qubit dephasing closures, compute and tabulate the 6x6 route-mismatch matrix (verifying RM=0 within contexts, >0 across), and certify (in Lean, upgrading mismatch_witness from generic Fin-4 to the PM observables) that no global commuting idempotent packaging map respecting the row/column product constraints exists -- i.e. KS/PM as 'no global packaging closure', discharging the line-888 future-work item with a clean control (record-diagonal family admits a global E_*).
card.execution_cost: low-to-moderate. Reusing thm:dephase, the route-mismatch definition, and the existing seeded Python/Lean scaffolding, the PM numerical instantiation (6 contexts, 6x6 RM matrix) is a few days of work. The conceptual/proof core -- making 'no global commuting closure respecting PM product constraints' a precise, ideally Lean-certified statement that genuinely encodes the PM anticommutation (not just generic noncommuting idempotents) -- is the hard part (the two hard lemmas) and is weeks of work with risk it only recovers a necessary condition.
card.honest_status_note: Grounded and faithfully scoped. The component pieces are real and Lean-certified (thm:dephase; route-mismatch Fin-4 witness mismatch_witness / not_commute_E_F), and the no-go premise-isolation (sec:no-go) is in the paper. BUT the central claim of R006 -- that contextuality IS closure noncommutation -- is an interpretational mapping the paper itself flags (line 746), NOT a theorem (class D correct). The certified witness is GENERIC noncommuting idempotents, not the PM-specific anticommutation; the Peres-Mermin instantiation is explicitly FUTURE WORK (line 888). SBT honors its disclaimers: no Born rule, no Bell resolution, no pointer-basis/record-algebra selection, no probability valuation, hence NO contextuality inequality/bound -- only the qualitative impossibility.

opposite_world_test.explanation: Route mismatch is fully controlled by hand-chosen record bases, H, and witness state. The candidate's own null-gate (record-diagonal / all-commuting family) gives RM_d=0 everywhere and a global E_* DOES exist -- a NONcontextual world -- produced with the same machinery by handing it compatible bases or a diagonal H. With no pointer-basis selection rule, nothing forces the contextual outcome; the diagnostic post-dicts whichever world a human declares.

audit.audit_verdict: HIGH flexibility / honest premise-isolation, NOT a derivation (consistent with class D). The core mechanism (idempotent dephasing closures + route mismatch RM_d) is real and Lean-certified, but ONLY for generic noncommuting idempotents on Fin 4 (mismatch_witness, not_commute_E_F) -- elementary linear algebra that does NOT encode the Peres-Mermin anticommutation/product-constraint structure making KS/PM a state-independent no-go. ~7 adjustable knobs plus a HIGH-risk added identity (value-assignment == commuting E_*) against ZERO independent quantitative data points; the only numbers reproduced (0.350099 generic, ~0 record-diagonal/ZX, 0.216506 tilted) merely restate the textbook fact that unitary evolution commutes with dephasing iff H is diagonal. OPPOSITE-WORLD FAILS. Mechanism reuses across LES/Jensen/dark-energy/double-slit, so it carries no contextuality-specific content. NET: honest recovery/reframing at class D; ad hoc only if presented as a DERIVATION of contextuality.

repair.repair_philosophy: Only allowed repairs applied: (1) narrowed the claim from an asserted identity/derivation ('contextuality IS closure noncommutation') to a precisely-bounded premise-isolation; (2) converted the sec:no-go prose into an explicit, stated necessary-condition lemma with honest logical-strength labeling (replacing rhetoric with a lemma sequence); (3) demoted the Fin-4 witness label from 'contextuality witness' to 'generic noncommuting-idempotent existence'; (4) split the overbroad single claim into (a) what is certified TODAY and (b) two NAMED OPEN lemmas (PM instantiation + value-map equivalence); (5) turned the qualitative 'match' into an explicit structural-impossibility correspondence with the standing caveat 'no contextuality inequality / no bound'. FORBIDDEN moves avoided: no arbitrary assumptions added, no hidden tuning, imported physics (Hilbert space, projectors, Lueders pinching, Born rule, PM product constraints, pointer bases) kept explicitly labeled as consumed, no unproven uniqueness asserted, no 'naturally emerges'. These repairs coincide with the panel's minimum-acceptance conditions and the card's own honest_status_note, so the result survives as a class-D premise-isolation but cannot be lifted to a derivation without the two hard lemmas (which would be future work, not a repair).
repair.revised_one_sentence_claim: SBT does not derive contextuality; it certifies (Lean) that idempotent packaging closures can fail to commute (generic noncommuting idempotents on Fin 4) and isolates, as a precise modeling lemma, that the Kochen-Specker / Peres-Mermin demand for a context-independent {0,1} value assignment maps to the demand for a single global idempotent packaging closure commuting with every context closure -- so the no-go's hidden premise is named 'one global commuting record language', while the PM-specific anticommutation (the state-independent obstruction) and the value-assignment<=>commuting-closure equivalence remain explicitly unproven, open lemmas (line 888).
repair.new_minimum_viable_result: Two cleanly separated deliverables: (A) CERTIFIED-TODAY (recovery): thm:dephase makes each context an idempotent closure (Lean dephase_idem); mismatch_witness/not_commute_E_F certify that noncommuting idempotent closures EXIST as a generic structural possibility (Fin 4, explicitly labeled NOT contextuality-specific); numerics restate the textbook fact RM_d=0 iff H diagonal in the record basis (0.350099 generic / ~0 record-diagonal/ZX, seed 0); and sec:no-go is upgraded from prose to a stated NECESSARY-CONDITION lemma: 'existence of a global idempotent {0,1}-conditional-expectation E_* commuting with every context closure is necessary for a noncontextual value assignment' (honest one-directional implication, sufficiency NOT claimed). (B) OPEN (would convert reframing to reorganization, NOT part of the accepted minimum): the line-888 PM instantiation as 6 two-qubit dephasing closures whose 6x6 route-mismatch matches the PM compatibility graph, with a Lean-certified proof that no global commuting E_* respecting the five-plus/one-minus product constraints exists, forced by PM anticommutation rather than generic noncommutation, plus a record-diagonal control where E_* provably exists.

remaining_objections: FATAL-CLASS (not repairable by narrowing): the contextuality-specific content is absent -- the certified witness is generic noncommuting idempotents on Fin 4 and cannot distinguish the PM square from any random noncommuting pair (RouteMismatch.lean 13-39). The value-assignment<=>commuting-E_* mapping is, even after repair, only a NECESSARY condition (a {0,1} valuation respecting functional relations is strictly stronger than a commuting idempotent CPTP map); the full equivalence requires added joint-diagonalizability structure not derivable within SBT.

Opposite-world failure persists: with no pointer-basis/record-algebra selection rule (named missing interface), the diagnostic post-dicts whichever bases a human supplies; the record-diagonal control produces a fully noncontextual world (RM=0, global E_* exists) from the same machinery. Imported physics does all the work (Hilbert space, projectors, Lueders pinching, e^{-iHt}, partial trace, einselected pointer bases, Born-rule diagonal probabilities, PM product constraints); SBT adds only the labels 'packaging closure' and 'route mismatch'.
Zero quantitative contextuality content: no probability valuation => no KCBS/PM-violation magnitude/contextual fraction; only qualitative impossibility. Zero independent data points matched.

Not novel even as a reframing: 'noncontextual assignment = global section / single commuting value map' is the standard content of the Abramsky-Brandenburger sheaf framework and the contextual fraction, which is strictly more powerful (it computes an obstruction); the proposed route-mismatch holonomy is speculative and unbuilt.

Route mismatch is explicitly a P3 protocol-geometry diagnostic that the ledger forbids promoting to a directionality/structural-invariant certificate; calling it a 'contextuality measure' is unsupported by the certificate spine.
repair.survives_as: An honest, faithfully-scoped premise-isolation / recovery at derivability class D. It is a legitimate conceptual-reframing artifact (name the smuggled premise; certify that noncommuting idempotent closures are a generic possibility) but is strictly weaker than the KS/PM theorem and carries no contextuality-specific or quantitative content until the two hard lemmas are proved. It does NOT survive as a derivation, retrodiction, or new prediction of contextuality.

score_rationale.impact: 2 -- contextuality is high-importance, but a premise-relabeling that derives nothing and produces no bound has low actual impact; the only forward value is naming the repair frontier (a pointer-basis selection rule).
score_rationale.execution_ease: 4 -- the CERTIFIED-TODAY pieces already exist (thm:dephase, Fin-4 witness, seeded numerics); the line-888 PM 6x6 instantiation is low-to-moderate (a few days). Capped below 5 because the genuinely load-bearing PM-anticommutation + equivalence lemmas are weeks of hard work with risk of only a necessary condition.
score_rationale.plausibility: 4 -- the certified components are true and the premise-isolation is a faithful, internally consistent reading; it does not overclaim once repaired. Not 5 because the central value-map<=>commuting-closure mapping is unproven and likely only necessary.
score_rationale.non_ad_hocness: 2 -- the machinery is built backwards from the target (context DEFINED as a dephasing closure precisely so noncommutation lands on incompatibility; the noncontextual premise RE-DESCRIBED to match KS/PM); target_used_to_design_theory=true. Lifted off the floor only because the underlying closure/route-mismatch primitives are independently certified and reused across domains, not bespoke to contextuality.
score_rationale.discriminative_power: 1 -- opposite-world test FAILS: the same machinery produces a noncontextual world (record-diagonal: RM=0, global E_* exists) from compatible hand-chosen inputs. With no pointer-basis selection rule it post-dicts whichever bases a human declares; it cannot distinguish PM from a generic noncommuting pair.
score_rationale.audience_legibility: 3 -- Lean-certified structural facts and a clean prose premise-isolation are legible to formal-methods and foundations audiences; but contextuality specialists will (correctly) read it as a relabeling of the standard commutator and a weaker version of the existing sheaf/contextual-fraction account, lowering legibility-as-contribution.
score_rationale.precision: 1 -- no probability valuation, no contextuality inequality, no bound; only qualitative structural impossibility, and the PM-specific obstruction is not encoded. SBT disclaimers (no Born rule, no probability valuation) cap precision at the floor.
score_rationale.robustness: 2 -- the certified linear-algebra facts are robust, but the contextuality CLAIM is fragile: it rests on an unproven interpretational identity, fails opposite-world, and the witness carries no PM-specific content; the reading flips with the hand-chosen bases.
score_rationale.baseline_advantage: 1 -- explicitly does NOT beat the standard account (it RECOVERS/REFRAMES it) and is weaker than the Abramsky-Brandenburger sheaf framework, which actually computes a contextuality obstruction. The card and all four skeptics concur beats_baseline=false. Disclaimers cap this.
score_rationale.publication_potential: 2 -- as-is, a relabeling with fatal-class objections has low standalone publication potential in quantum foundations. The line-888 PM instantiation (if it genuinely encoded anticommutation and proved no-global-E_*) could be a modest formal-methods / foundations note, but that is the unproven future work, not the current artifact.

recommended_artifact: Deliver the CERTIFIED-TODAY package as an honest premise-isolation note (thm:dephase per-context closure + Fin-4 generic noncommuting-idempotent witness + numerics restating 'U commutes with dephasing iff H diagonal' + the sec:no-go necessary-condition lemma), explicitly labeling the Fin-4 witness as NON-contextuality-specific and the PM instantiation + value-map equivalence as open. Only IF the line-888 PM 6x6 instantiation AND a Lean proof of no-global-E_* forced by PM anticommutation (not generic noncommutation) are achieved should it be elevated beyond bin E; absent that it stays a low-priority conceptual reframing.
